title: What should the product own as models get better?
intro: Early discussions challenged the value of a lightweight stage: if an Agent can build a scene in code—or work with a tool like Blender—why create another environment?

My decision was to separate scene generation from directing and editing. Better models could improve the starting point. The product needed to preserve the creator’s decisions and make the next change understandable.

items.label: THE EXPERIENCE TO BUILD
items.title: An editable directing workflow
items.text: Keep space, movement and camera choices available for the next revision.

items.label: THE FOUNDATION THAT CAN EVOLVE
items.title: Scene creation & assets
items.text: Start with lightweight white-block scenes. Leave room for stronger generation and future asset sources.

blocks.label: A DELIBERATE SCOPE
blocks.text: Rehearse the shot before refining the look.

body: White-block models made proportion, occlusion and timing visible without requiring production-ready assets. I kept the first experience focused on staging and shooting; final visual treatment remained downstream. Professional-tool interoperability was an extension direction, not a delivered Blender round trip.
